_source: TFR Supply Valor Police Launch SKUs — validated 2026-06-29. Filter + Add-ons model rebuild (2026-07-06): filter steps only reflect the 8 already-validated Police SKUs in shopify-variant-index.json — no new SKUs invented.
_note: 8 Police Valor SKUs. Length and mount confirmed from SKU structure. Color confirmed from suffix; colorConfig (single/dual/tri) is a direct 1:1 restatement of that same confirmed color code, not a new inference. Control Architecture and Primary Warning Colors have no corresponding attribute anywhere in the real Valor catalog (every Police SKU here is a Blue/White or Amber/Blue/White combination) and are presented as informational steps only — they do not filter the SKU list. The catalog also contains VALR44J-F2H/VALR51J-F2H (Fire/NFPA), VALR44J-P1C/no-51-equivalent (unconfirmed mount code "C"), and VALR44J/51J-AMBR2/AMBR3 (Work Truck, currently unavailable) — all out of scope for this Police-only configurator per the existing product framing. MSRP: prices resolve at runtime from shopify-variant-index.json — do NOT invent prices.
